query:
WITH to_delete AS (
                    SELECT up.user_password_id
                    FROM user_passwords up
                    JOIN users u USING (user_id)
                    WHERE u.deactivated_at < $1
                    LIMIT $2
                )
                DELETE FROM user_passwords
                USING to_delete
                WHERE user_passwords.user_password_id = to_delete.user_password_id
